def add(name, entry_name, config=None):
    """
    Add an entry to the sshconfig.
    """
    if config is None:
        config = Config()

    if config.has_section(name):
        raise Exception("Entry already exists.")

    config.add_section(name)
    config.set(name, entry_name, config.get(entry_name, entry_name))

    config.save()
